claimTypes.maySay: Directly observed current/previous move, capture, drop, promotion, check, side-in-check.
claimTypes.traceRule: fact id or exact engine state

claimTypes.maySay: A verified change between before/after context such as check resolved, newly created attack, exchange sequence.
claimTypes.cannotSay: That the change was the player's purpose unless selected Intent independently supports it.
claimTypes.traceRule: contextChange id plus source evidence where causal

claimTypes.maySay: Observable consequence such as mobility increase, escape-square reduction, added control/defender.
claimTypes.cannotSay: 'to achieve X', 'aimed to X', or 'for the purpose of X' solely from the effect.

claimTypes.maySay: Only the already selected MoveIntent, calibrated by existing confidence.
claimTypes.cannotSay: New/deferred concept as purpose; alternate intent; purpose inferred from effect/geometry/opening name.
claimTypes.traceRule: selectedIntent plus compatible source evidence; no explanation-layer re-resolution

claimTypes.maySay: Observed/verified result such as material capture or stable comparison outcome.
claimTypes.cannotSay: Reverse the outcome into a reason without causal evidence.
claimTypes.traceRule: outcome id or explicit verified engine state

claimTypes.maySay: A directly inspectable missing/unstable evidence reason.
claimTypes.cannotSay: Speculative reasons for why evidence is missing.
claimTypes.traceRule: missingEvidence rule condition must evaluate true

promotionRules.FACT->INTENT: FORBIDDEN unless Intent already exists from resolver; fact may only support wording.
